edits.before: - Neeko Tangle-Barbs (Root): matchup-defining — The root sets up her whole burst — sidestep it behind minions. It writes your spacing rules. - R Stranglethorns is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Neeko's Tangle-Barbs (E) is down 12s at rank 1, only 10s at rank 5 — sidestep it and punish that window immediately. - Your Stranglethorns (R) is 110/100/90s; hold it to knock her out of the Pop Blossom channel, not to season a poke trade.
